mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of building an in-law suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: The total cost of building an in-law addition depends on the construction type, total square footage, utility requirements, and chosen finishes. Converting interior space or a garage generally costs less than building a custom ground-up addition that requires site excavation, a new foundation, exterior framing, and roofing. Adding a full bathroom with plumbing rough-ins, tile, and a walk-in shower will add more to the budget than a simple bedroom expansion. Other major cost factors include electrical panel upgrades, HVAC capacity, and custom cabinetry. Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms reviews options during consultations to align project scope with your budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on whether you build new or convert existing space, the overall square footage, required plumbing for bathrooms, electrical needs, and chosen interior finishes.
